verdict.reasoning: The rendered page (printed p.773, PDF p.795) shows Figure E.6 as three boxed labels, Person, Employee and Manager, stacked vertically, with a filled arrowhead from Manager pointing up to Employee and from Employee pointing up to Person. page-795.md keeps only the three labels as separate paragraphs and the caption. It has no boxes, no arrows and no description of them, so the figure's relationship content is missing from the transcription. Both sources are quoted correctly. The paragraph after the figure states the same hierarchy in words, and Annex E is informative, so the loss is cosmetic, as the claim says. No normative content is lost.
